element_fields.help_en:
The object to be detected. Each element in the JSON array is a text detection task structure.

N Tasks are counted as N calls for billing purposes.
For questions about algorithm detection accuracy, join the Alibaba Cloud Visual Intelligence Platform consultation group on DingTalk (group ID: 23109592)
element_fields.help_zh:
指定检测的对象，JSON数组中的每个元素是一个文字检测任务结构体。

N个Task会折算为N次调用进行计费。
算法识别效果问题请通过钉钉群（23109592）加入阿里云视觉智能开放平台咨询群联系我们
element_fields.name: content

element_fields.help_en:
The common scenario for text detection. Valid values:

spam: spam text detection

politics: sensitive text detection

abuse: abuse text detection

terrorism: terrorism text detection

porn: pornographic text detection

flood: flood text detection

contraband: contraband text detection

ad: advertising text detection
element_fields.help_zh:
指定文本检测的应用场景，可选值包括：

spam：文字垃圾内容识别

politics：文字敏感内容识别

abuse：文字辱骂内容识别

terrorism：文字暴恐内容识别

porn：文字鉴黄内容识别

flood：文字灌水内容识别

contraband：文字违禁内容识别

ad：文字广告内容识别
